title: ambi_reduced_decode_fir2
description: `ambi_reduced_decode_fir2` supports Ambisonic binaural decoding by calculating a reduced decoder from real and phantom loudspeaker positions, Ambisonic order weights, and left-ear HRIRs, using a pseudo-inverse. After configuring the layout and loading HRIRs, send `calc_pinv` to start encoding, then use `calc_reduced` with an Ambisonic channel index to multiply that decoder column by the HRIR matrix and fadeout table.
